facts.detail: Ofcom published the proposed 2026/27 Plan of Work on 5 December 2025.
Ofcom published the final statement on 20 March 2026.
The annual priorities are based on Ofcom's Three Year Plan 2025–2028.
The plan lists four strategic priorities covering reliable internet and post, trusted media, online safety and wireless enablement.
An interactive Project Annex sets out key milestones for the year ahead.

facts.detail: Ofcom published the Planned Network Deployments 2026 report on 13 May 2026.
The report uses operator plans stated in January 2026 and examines the following three years through the end of 2028.
Ofcom estimates 73% of UK homes, or 22.2 million, could access at least two gigabit-capable networks by the end of 2028.
Ofcom estimates 36% of UK homes, or 11.1 million, could access at least three gigabit-capable networks by the end of 2028.
The report identifies around 6,950 additional geographically distinct FWA masts planned or due for upgrade between January 2026 and January 2029.

facts.detail: Ofcom last updated the Planned Network Deployment collection on 13 May 2026.
The latest report is forward-looking and examines anticipated full-fibre and gigabit-capable coverage through the end of 2028.
The report includes operator plans funded privately and plans supported through public funding or intervention.
The analysis does not separately include national or local authority rollout aspirations that are not operator deployment plans.
The Planned Network Deployment report supplements Ofcom's Connected Nations infrastructure reporting.
